scenes.caption: Where did your allowance go?
scenes.vo: OJT life, right? Fare, food, load... and your allowance is gone before Friday.

scenes.caption: OJT Budget
scenes.vo: Meet OJT Budget. It's free, it works offline, and your data stays on your phone.

scenes.caption: Tap Get started
scenes.vo: Download it from the link, then tap Get started.

scenes.caption: Your name and school
scenes.vo: Add your name and school. No sign-up needed.

scenes.caption: Pick your agency
scenes.vo: Pick your agency, so your fares match your area.

scenes.caption: Where do you live?
scenes.vo: Living at home, renting, or in a dorm? It handles all three.

scenes.caption: Your OJT schedule
scenes.vo: Set your schedule: start date, hours per day, and required hours.

scenes.caption: Save your route
scenes.vo: In Commute, save your route to the office, one ride at a time.

scenes.caption: Fares, auto-computed
scenes.vo: Your fare is computed for you. One way and round trip, right away.

scenes.caption: Ready every day
scenes.vo: Saved. Your daily route is ready to log.

scenes.caption: One tap to log
scenes.vo: Hit the plus button. Meals and fares take just one tap.

scenes.caption: Undo anytime
scenes.vo: Logged instantly. Made a mistake? Just hit Undo.

scenes.caption: Set a budget
scenes.vo: Set a budget, like a thousand pesos for food each week.

scenes.caption: Safe to spend today
scenes.vo: Your Home screen shows exactly how much is safe to spend today.

scenes.caption: Updates, 8 PM to 12 AM
scenes.vo: For updates, open the app between 8 PM and midnight, then tap Restart.

scenes.caption: Download now
scenes.vo: Download it now from the link in the group chat. Your OJT, minus the money stress.
